name: Takayama
blurb: Online conversation about Takayama is currently quiet, reflecting a 64% decrease compared to its baseline. Visitors frequently discuss local culinary highlights such as Hida beef, cultural attractions like the morning markets and museums, and trips to nearby Shirakawa-go.

positive: Enjoying Hida beef skewers and local food
Visiting the morning market, festival float museum, and retro museum
Taking early morning bus trips to Shirakawa-go
negative: Shirakawa-go gets extremely crowded by mid-morning
Some historical temples outside town are met with reluctance by locals to discuss them

quotes.text:
Hida-Takayama is a Japanese treasure. Many international visitors come here, and the vast majority are drawn by Hida beef.
#飛騨高山
#飛騨牛

Today we went through the morning market in Takayama, visited the festival float museum and the carpentry museum in hida.
Now we are in Tokyo our last stop for our vacation

One of the more memorable and interesting things Maddie and I did in Japan last year was check out the Showa Era retro museum in Takayama. A nice compilation of pop culture relics from the past 50ish years, particularly interesting in the lines that intersected with US pop culture

Nobody tells you this but Shirakawa-go gets PACKED by 10am 😅 Take the first bus from Takayama at 7:50 and you'll have the village almost to yourself. Trust me, those thatched roofs hit different in morning mist 🏔️ #JapanTravel #VisitJapan
